name: Charge
description: A balance that is normally due in full at the end of a billing period

name: Credit
description: Funds extended by an issuer and repaid under a credit agreement

name: Debit
description: Funds drawn from a linked deposit or transaction account

name: Other
description: A known funding model outside the named normalized values

name: Prepaid
description: Value funded before it is used for payment

name: Unknown
description: The funding model was not supplied or could not be determined
